articles.title: Indian Army orders 840 one-way attack drones from Tata, Nibe for ₹1,577 crore
articles.summary: The Indian Army has finalized contracts worth ₹1,577 crore to acquire domestically produced one-way attack drones, with deliveries expected within 12 months. This significant procurement marks the first major order under an initiative to boost indigenous defence manufacturing. It aims to enhance the Army's modern warfare capabilities and operational readiness using advanced, home-grown drone technology.
